Madison Women's Cycling Club Tuesday Ride

Madison, WI · Atwood · Road · Social

Women / trans / femmeNo-dropBeginner friendly

Madison Women's Cycling Club Tuesday Ride is a road and social group ride in Madison, WI. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from Olbrich Park (Biergarten parking lot). About 12 miles, casual, with a sweep rider. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual, with a sweep rider. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Madison Women's Cycling Club Tuesday Ride group ride

A relaxed lake loop for women, trans and non-binary riders. About 12 miles with a sweep so nobody rides alone. Most weeks there are two route options, posted on the club's Instagram before the ride.
